title: TCS Sydney Marathon 2026 course page — linked GPX file
claims: The 2026 TCS Sydney Marathon course page at https://www.tcssydneymarathon.com/course (which resolves to /marathon) offers a 'Download Marathon Course GPX File' link and states that the course route is 100% accurate in the GPX while the elevation is not 100% accurate.
The linked GPX URL carries dn=TCS_Sydney_Marathon_2026_Course.gpx; a GET on 2026-11-21 returned HTTP 200, application/gpx+xml and 52,384 bytes.

The file is GPX 1.1 with creator Garmin Connect and contains 650 trkpt, no wpt and 650 <ele> elements; its metadata name is 'TCS Sydney Marathon 2025 - 42.195 km' (repeated), metadata time 2026-08-03T10:03:42 and metadata link https://www.goandrace.com.

A local haversine sum over the 650 trackpoints gives 42.2424 km, 47.4 m (0.112%) longer than the official 42.195 km; the first point is -33.833204, 151.208004, the last is -33.858142, 151.214300, and the bounding box is 33.833204–33.931257 S / 151.191888–151.241047 E.

The 650 elevation values sum raw to +283 m / −357 m, with a minimum of 3.8 m and a maximum of 80.4 m; the official page states GPX elevation is not 100% accurate and publishes +313/−396 m (with +317/−400 m also present on the same page), so this page keeps the official figures and does not substitute the raw GPX sums.
The file has no copyright line or redistribution licence; the page links it only and does not copy it into site media, bundle it or draw the track.
